summary: Perspective Therapeutics filed a routine Form -8K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release and poster of updated interim Phase 1/2a data for [212Pb]lapemelanotide zapixetar (VMT01) in heavily pretreated advanced melanoma, presented at SITC 2026 in Phoenix (November 4-8, 2026). Reported results include a 75% disease control rate at the 3.0 mCi monotherapy dose, two confirmed responders with one on study roughly 40 weeks after first treatment, and no dose-limiting toxicities or treatment-related serious adverse events across 20 patients. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is stated; the filing is a clinical/regulatory disclosure, not a special situation.
